Vanishing R would contradict this. Consequently eTi = viR with real vi. The shell test of both R and eTi tends to the same nonzero y, for the latter by TR43 and tested derivative comparison. Linearity and division give vi →1, Multiplying TR43–TR44 by v−1 hence eventual nonzero vi. transfers both limits to R. TR40 i removes its unit shift and gives the selected trace limit used in TR2. The lifted correction source retains the three candidates, exact kernel detector, inverse matrix and Ward shell test. TR41 is its finite correction reader, and TR42 recovers its scalar coordinate with the numerical sign intact. Rank–nullity and the nonzero charge reader identify the same physical stress line; normalization by vi then recovers the actual Ward-normalized tensor rather than an arbitrarily scaled conserved representative.
